decisive_items: Mycological culture yielded growth of Trichophyton mentagrophytes
response.rationale: R1 directly pairs the definitive mycological culture with the characteristic skin lesion description, covering both etiology and anatomy. C1 adds the specific species but omits the lesion description, making it a less complete raw-span match. R2 relies on nonspecific eosinophilia and IgE elevation without a raw diagnostic confirmation.

rejected.why: Elevated eosinophils and IgE are nonspecific and not supported by a definitive raw diagnostic test; the culture result strongly favors dermatophytosis.
